description: eljazari.ai safety rules — machine-readable format for RAG compliance checker

compliance_rules.name: no_infinite_loops
compliance_rules.description: Infinite loops without exit conditions are forbidden
compliance_rules.suggestion: Add a break/timeout condition to all while loops

compliance_rules.name: no_direct_motor_commands
compliance_rules.description: Direct motor/PWM commands bypass safety — use Skill APIs only
compliance_rules.suggestion: Use takeoff(), fly_to(), land() instead of direct motor control

compliance_rules.name: no_hardcoded_credentials
compliance_rules.description: Passwords, tokens, or API keys must not appear in flight code

compliance_rules.name: no_shell_execution
compliance_rules.description: Shell commands in flight code are a security violation
compliance_rules.suggestion: Remove all shell/eval/exec calls from flight code

compliance_rules.name: async_main_function
compliance_rules.description: Mission entry point must be an async function
compliance_rules.suggestion: Define an async def run()/mission() as the mission entry point

compliance_rules.name: battery_check_before_takeoff
compliance_rules.description: Battery level should be checked before arming/takeoff
compliance_rules.suggestion: Add get_battery(system) check before takeoff and abort if < 50%

compliance_rules.name: no_positive_z_fly_to
compliance_rules.description: In NED coordinates, positive z means underground. fly_to() z must be negative for above-ground flight
compliance_rules.suggestion: Use negative z values in fly_to() for above-ground flight (NED: North+X, East+Y, Down+Z)

compliance_rules.name: connection_string_parameterised
compliance_rules.description: Connection string must be parameterised, not hardcoded
compliance_rules.suggestion: Read connection string from environment: os.getenv('MAVLINK_CONNECTION', 'udp://:14540')

compliance_rules.name: no_sleep_in_flight_loop
compliance_rules.description: time.sleep() blocks the event loop — use asyncio.sleep() instead

compliance_rules.name: no_threading_in_flight_code
compliance_rules.description: Threading conflicts with MAVSDK async event loop
compliance_rules.suggestion: Use asyncio.create_task() or asyncio.gather() instead of threads

static_analysis_rules.name: approved_functions_only
static_analysis_rules.description: All function calls must be from approved Skill APIs
static_analysis_rules.suggestion: Replace with an approved Skill API function

static_analysis_rules.name: landing_sequence_required
static_analysis_rules.description: Code must contain land() or emergency_stop() call
static_analysis_rules.suggestion: Add land(system) or emergency_stop(system) at the end

static_analysis_rules.name: error_handling_required
static_analysis_rules.description: All flight operations must be in try/except blocks
static_analysis_rules.suggestion: Wrap flight operations in try/except with safe landing fallback

static_analysis_rules.name: altitude_bounds
static_analysis_rules.description: No commanded altitude above MAX_ALTITUDE_M or below 0

reachability_rules.name: battery_return_margin
reachability_rules.description: Must have ≥30% battery margin for RTL from any waypoint
reachability_rules.suggestion: Reduce mission range or shorten path distance

reachability_rules.name: geofence_compliance
reachability_rules.description: All waypoints must be within defined geofence radius
reachability_rules.suggestion: Keep all waypoints within MAX_GEOFENCE_RADIUS_M of home

injection_protocols.name: battery_monitor
injection_protocols.description: Async battery monitor — RTL when battery < 20%

injection_protocols.name: connection_watchdog
injection_protocols.description: Monitor connection state — emergency_stop on disconnect

injection_protocols.name: geofence_enforcer
injection_protocols.description: Monitor position — RTL when geofence is breached
